title: STRIXED 2.0
author: elastrixx
body: That's right! I'm back with a huge update to the site, finally bringing the pages for Starbound, Rifted and other stuff that never worked!! Starting off with this blogpost! This is the general blog for the page and other stuff involving me, but don't worry about reading boring stuff to look for news on my projects, each project has their own page too! Rifted and Starbound currently have also launched their news pages and you can look at them on the 'Projects' tab on the sidebar
footnote: I'm thinking of making something to subscribe to the newsletters and be able to know when theres new posts, but that'll come later, for now you'll have to settle with peeping every so often... hehehe......anyways! There's still stuff coming up soon-ish and that hamburger knows something... Also shoutout Lily for checking on the page constantly during the wait for the new update <3
